text:
Omar: hey all, first day here — trying to open the model-slo-overview Grafana (https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/zt1-model-slo) but getting a SSO/MFA error: "mfa_required". anyone seen this during onboarding?
Priya: welcome Omar!! :tada: usually that means Okta has the app assigned but you haven't finished factor enrollment (we require 2FA). are you getting an Okta prompt or an error page?
Omar: browser shows a plain error page from grafana: "SAML assertion rejected: missing required authentication context (mfa_required)". I did enroll phone push but not a hardware key.
onboard-bot: Hi Omar! Please check the onboarding checklist and complete MFA enrollment: https://go/redwood/onboard-checklist. Also submit an Observability access request if you haven't: https://go/redwood/obs-access
Kai: tagging eng-observability — @Priya if Okta shows user assigned, I can trigger a re-provision to Grafana. Omar, try completing Okta MFA setup (push + TOTPs) and then hard-refresh Grafana (ctrl+shift+R).
Omar: enrolled phone push and added an authenticator app. still 403 with same mfa_required message.
Priya: hm, sometimes Okta side shows you as "partially enrolled" until a device is verified. Go to https://okta.redwood.com -> Security -> Multifactor and confirm devices listed. If that's clean, the other cause is the Grafana SAML assertion expecting a hardware key (we recently tightened policy for infra teams).
Omar: my multifactor page shows only "Okta Verify" and SMS. no hardware key. I don't have a YubiKey.
Kai: ok that's the stricter policy for grafana-team:infra-admins, but for viewers we require 2FA but not hardware. Are you trying to open an admin dashboard? model-slo-overview is read-only for most folks. what's your Okta groups list?
Omar: groups: engineers, model-eng, new-hires. not infra-observers. I probably wasn't auto-mapped. I included Grafana: model-slo-overview and Datadog: model-prod in the obs-access form (req #11822).
Priya: obs-access looks good. Kai, can you map new-hires -> grafana-team:infra-observers so Omar gets Viewer access?
Kai: done — mapped new-hires group to grafana-team:infra-observers and forced a sync. Omar try incognito + clear cookies.
Omar: tried incognito and can load Grafana now! I can see panels but the deploy annotations are missing and Sentry project "model-service" doesn't show in my Sentry UI. Datadog still 403.
infra-bot: Datadog invite status: user omar@redwood.com pending (invite sent) — Datadog requires org invite acceptance and sometimes IP allowlist. See https://go/redwood/datadog-onboard.
Priya: good notes — for Datadog we send an email invite; accept it and set up 2FA there too. For Sentry, project membership is granted after the obs-access ticket completes identity mapping. I see #11822 is pending approval by security for SSO mapping (they're doing a quick policy check).
Omar: any way to test alerts or run queries meanwhile? need to validate a dashboard panel against a recent rollout.
Kai: you can use the staging Datadog and staging Grafana links (we don't send alerts from staging). I'll add you to the staging alert channel and add a temporary folder-view on a staging copy of model-slo-overview so you can run queries. That avoids waiting on security for production mapping.
Omar: that works, thanks. one last Q — who owns the model-slo-overview dashboard if I need to request visual changes?
Priya: owner is @maria-models (metadata in the dashboard). For edits we ask folks to fork and create a PR via our dashboard repo; owners review. If you need small visual tweaks for onboarding, ping Maria or we can apply a temporary annotation for your testing.
Omar: great, can see staging dashboard and verify panels. prod access looks good for Grafana now, Datadog invite pending, Sentry pending. thanks everyone for the quick help :rocket:
thread_text_short: New hire Omar hits SSO/MFA error for Grafana; Priya and Kai walk through Okta MFA and group mapping, Kai maps new-hires to grafana team and Omar gets Viewer access; Datadog/Sentry invites pending (obs-access #11822), staging access provided for testing.
